scenario_description:
Objective: Improve Sunday's dishwasher cleanup by adding a compatible no-cost cleaner packet if the brief lobby-sample hold route becomes usable.
Emerging Need: The offer starts speculative, then current film on glassware, confirmed compatible stock, and a same-day hold cutoff align.
Decision Context: Stored appliance guidance supplies the dishwasher model and safe cleaner type; live calendar, building notice, contact, and household updates determine whether a set-aside can help.
Consequence: Ignoring the chance leaves ordinary cleaning and normal dishwasher use, while after holds close the optional packet cannot be secured around the Friday table conflict.

parameter.title: Sunday dishwasher interior cleanup
parameter.description: Wipe door gasket, clear filter cup, and run the routine interior cleanup if supplies are available.

parameter.title: North Loop reference photo handoff
parameter.description: Off-site handoff and brief review with the archive desk.

parameter.subject: Friday lobby appliance-care table preliminary note
parameter.body: A supplier may bring a small batch of no-cost appliance-care samples to the lobby table this Friday from 11:00 AM to noon. The final stock list is still being counted, and the desk is not taking holds until a separate intake card posts later today.

parameter.content: The glasses I used yesterday came out with a chalky film again. Not a problem, but if you're already doing the dishwasher cleanup Sunday, a proper cleaner packet would be a nice upgrade.

parameter.name: Loring House Appliance Table Intake
parameter.notes: Posted 2026-10-14 for Friday 11:00 AM-noon lobby appliance-care table. Same-day email holds accepted until 1:30 PM today for residents unavailable during the table. One no-cost Bosch-compatible citric-acid dishwasher cleaner packet can be set aside when the request includes unit number and dishwasher model.

parameter.subject: Appliance-care sample holds are now closed
parameter.body: The 1:30 PM hold window for Friday's appliance-care table has closed, and the desk cannot add more set-asides. Any remaining dishwasher cleaner packets will be walk-up only during the 11:00 AM-noon lobby table on Friday.
